title: How Do Americans Engage With News Online?
summary_en: Most Americans chat privately about news online, but only about a quarter post publicly.
title_cn: How Do Americans Engage With News Online?

title: What Do Health and Wellness Influencers Post About?
summary_en: Just over half of health and wellness content on social media focuses on healthy living, while about a third discusses medical topics. And 38% of posts have a product or service promotion.
title_cn: What Do Health and Wellness Influencers Post About?
